name: Repair nested JSON flattening
prompt: Repair flatten(data, separator='.') in flattener.py. Flatten dictionaries and lists recursively, joining dictionary keys and zero-based list indexes with separator. Preserve scalar values (including null/false/0/empty strings). An empty dictionary/list is a leaf; at the root its key is ''. A root scalar also uses key ''. Support a custom nonempty separator. Do not mutate input values. Dictionary keys in this task are strings without the separator; test fixtures have no ambiguous key paths. The visible tests are examples; only submit flattener.py. Existing dictionary/scalar behavior must continue to work.
